market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil >$100 and PPI shock drive risk-off; Nasdaq under pressure. Dow/S&P may snap losing streak on earnings but upside capped by inflation fears. Fed credibility crisis creates two-way volatility. Expect 3-5% equity drawdown risk if Iran escalation continues.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle has 12-18 months of runway but Goldman's bubble warning implies mean-reversion risk by Q1 2027. Apple product cycle and China policy pivot offer offsetting upside. Structural defense spending and energy transition (GEV, FuelCell) provide secular support. Key risk: stagflation if oil stays >$100 through 2027.
